The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Says to revert to the last known good release first and fix afterwards, with the mechanism (stability before cleverness under pressure)
- Refuses the direct push to the default branch; the fix goes through a pull request and CI, or branches from the released tag if a revert is impossible
- Mentions checking whether the release included a migration the old code cannot run against, and acknowledging the incident and holding a blameless review afterwards

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
